summary: The mechanical half of #148's criteria runs by rule against the live forge. Of five candidates checked, the three revealed #138 pull requests were excluded by E1 against the derived reservation set, and two recent merges were excluded by E2 against the recomputed freshness threshold of 2026-03-12 - one of them also by E5, having no GitHub-native review trail. No candidate was passed on anything the script could not read: an unreadable field is recorded unknown and unknown never counts as a pass.
establishes: That E1, E2, E3 and E5 are applied by rule rather than by hand, and that the extended reservation set derived from the revealed inventory - 79 pull requests from 28 inventory rows plus #148's own list and exclusion log - actually excludes the burned candidates when a hunt asks about them.
residual: This is machinery, not selection. E4, E6 to E10 stay with the curator and E11 with the adjudicator, and no candidate here is a target.
read_from: the probe's own retained output, not asserted beside it
